title: Character presence contract
description: Look is versioned separately from performance. The presence block is the stable, testable definition of how a character occupies frame. It is enforced by gates, not by prompt wording.

presence_version.description: Bump on any behavioural change. Every render records the version it was made under so a season stays coherent.

look.description: Wardrobe, silhouette, reference images. Changing this does NOT change presence_version.

presence.description: Behavioural direction, expressed as observable on-screen facts.

negatives.description: Observable behaviours that must never appear. Each maps to a measurable gate.

gates.description: Measured thresholds for this character. Absent = inherit default thresholds.

stillness_max.description: max mean inter-frame luminance delta inside the character box

duplicate_max.description: max fraction of duplicate frames; above this the clip is rejected

eyeline_max_deg.description: max degrees off the co-actor before it counts as camera-facing

beat.description: where in the timeline this is true
